description: This file contains functional test cases for the EmployeeMembershipAPI class within the OrangeHRM project. It tests methods such as getOne, getAll, create, update, delete, and validation rules, verifying API behavior for employee membership management in the HRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipAPITest
classes.description: Test suite for the EmployeeMembershipAPI class, focusing on CRUD operations, validation, and integration within the HRM API context of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Load fixture data for testing employee membership entities from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeMembershipService
methods.description: Verify that the API correctly returns an instance of EmployeeMembershipService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Test retrieval of a single employee membership record, including related currency info and DateTime fields.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validate the API's request validation rules for fetching a single record based on employee number and ID.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Test deletion of employee membership records, ensuring proper DAO method calls and exception handling.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validate the request validation for deleting employee memberships, including employee number and IDs.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Test updating an employee membership, including data setting, DAO interactions, and currency retrieval.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validate the API's request rules for updating a membership, ensuring required parameters are present.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Test creation of a new employee membership, verifying DAO save operation and response correctness.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validate validation rules for creating a new membership, checking for necessary input data.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Test fetching multiple employee memberships for an employee, including aggregation and currency info.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validate request parameters for retrieving all memberships for an employee.
